TrainingConfig.title: TrainingConfig
TrainingConfig.description: Configuration for the active training title and session dates.

title.description: Official training title displayed on the attendance sheet.

dates.description: Ordered list of training dates in DD/MM/YYYY format.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

updatedBy.description: UID or email of the admin who updated the configuration.

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Participant attendance submission with digital signature for a specific training date.

sessionDate.description: Training date signed by the participant in DD/MM/YYYY format.

signatureDataUrl.description: Base64 PNG data URL of the participant digital signature.

trainingTitle.description: Snapshot of the training title at the time of attendance submission.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized PIC admin record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin user.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/training_config/{configId}.description: Active training title and schedule configuration (doc ID: current).

/attendances/{attendanceId}.description: Participant attendance logs with digital signatures.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Admin role directory keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
